# VisDelta: start here for agents

Current package: visdelta@0.4.2. Copy this complete HTML into index.html,
serve it over HTTP (for example `npx serve .`), and open the printed URL.

```html
<!doctype html>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/visdelta@0.4.2/dist/visdelta.css">
<div id="chart" style="width:100%;max-width:640px;height:400px"></div>
<script type="module">
  import { bar, transition, visualizationWarnings }
    from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/visdelta@0.4.2/+esm';
  const rows = [
    { product: 'Hardware', revenue: 12, profit: 5 },
    { product: 'Software', revenue: 18, profit: 11 },
    { product: 'Services', revenue: 9, profit: 7 },
  ];
  const from = bar(rows).x('product').y('revenue').key('product');
  const to = from.y('profit');
  console.log(await visualizationWarnings(to));
  const change = await transition(from, to, {
    target: '#chart', width: 'auto', height: 400,
  });
  // A complete, synchronous endpoint. play() returns a controller, not a Promise.
  change.progress(1);
</script>
```

## Invariants and current boundaries

- Supply tidy rows. Declare each encoding; there is no implicit color field.
- Keep source-record identity (datumKey) separate from mark identity (key).
- where() changes membership; highlight() changes emphasis; focus() moves the
  camera without filtering. Filters do not reset category colors or legends.
- Line fits inferred x/y domains to visible rows. Other charts have their own
  domain rules: do not assume where() always refits every chart's axes.
- Explicit valid numeric/temporal position domains are not niced. Inferred
  domains may be rounded. Write fixed domains only when the story needs them.
- Decide whether dates mean local calendar time or absolute instants before
  parsing. The temporal axis uses local-time scaleTime; there is no utc option.
- Every frame couples marks and the scales/axes that explain them. Source data,
  semantic changes, planned stages and rendered frames are distinct layers.
- transition progress is 0..1. sequence progress is 0..states.length-1:
  1.5 means halfway through the second leg. A stage is not a state-change count.
- duration is per serial route stage, not per whole story. play() is not awaitable.
- Await transition()/sequence() before seeking; there is no additional ready.
- inspect() reports compiled SVG property tracks. It is not a mark snapshot.
  state.resolve(), inspect(t), global strict/debug and bindScroll are unavailable.
- The optional Unit directionalEase profile is an exception to strict identical
  forward/reverse frames. Follow the chart-specific contract instead of guessing.

## Verification workflow

1. Check tidy rows, field types and unique identities; preserve the source state.
2. Inspect state.rows(), state.toSpec(), delta(a, b).stateChanges and
   await visualizationWarnings(state). These work without rendering for inline
   or supplied named data; warnings do not fetch a remote dataset for you.
3. Await creation, seek exact endpoints, and inspect stageCount(), stageChanges(),
   stageOperations() and await inspect() on pair controllers. A sequence exposes
   inspect() for its active leg, not the pair's stage-count methods.
4. Check actual mark geometry, visibility and axes in a browser. Cover forward,
   reverse, scroll/scrub, resizing and reduced motion. Compare endpoints with
   independent static charts under the same dimensions, margins and theme.
5. Use screenshots for final appearance checks; a successful import or an SVG
   element alone does not prove the chart is drawn correctly.

## Copy a tested story instead of inventing a scroll controller

- [Single-file scroll story](https://songhaifan.github.io/visdelta/templates/scroll-story.html)
- [Agent workflow](https://songhaifan.github.io/visdelta/docs/guides/agent-workflow/)
- [Automatic behaviors](https://songhaifan.github.io/visdelta/docs/guides/automatic-behaviors/)
- [Scroll template and iframe contract](https://songhaifan.github.io/visdelta/docs/guides/scroll-template/)
- [Progress model](https://songhaifan.github.io/visdelta/docs/concepts/progress/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://songhaifan.github.io/visdelta/docs/guides/troubleshooting/)

Repository template: examples/templates/scroll-story.html. Its inline data is
fictional, and its only network dependencies are pinned VisDelta JS and CSS.
A content-height iframe needs manual controls or a cooperating parent page;
child scroll code cannot observe cross-origin parent scrolling on its own.

## API and semantic references

- [Reference](https://songhaifan.github.io/visdelta/docs/api/)
- [Machine-readable page index](https://songhaifan.github.io/visdelta/llms.txt)
- [Complete current documentation](https://songhaifan.github.io/visdelta/llms-full.txt)

The repository's semantic constitution is docs/language-framework.md;
docs/reference.md records implemented behavior. Public entries include visdelta,
visdelta/core, visdelta/area, visdelta/bar, visdelta/line, visdelta/point,
visdelta/unit, visdelta/pie, visdelta/facet, visdelta/transition, visdelta/plugins,
visdelta/toolkit, visdelta/chart-style, visdelta/browser and visdelta/style.css.
Diagnostic API proposals are design documents, not available exports.
